native_conflicts.details: RXN18395 omits the product proton included in current Rhea52385. RXN19820/19822 add product H+ absent in current Rhea59125/59129. All seven current full Rhea equations independently balance with ChEBI255 charge/formulas; native equations cannot be declared exact current equation matches.

CPD21431/21432/21433/12590 leave citrate stereochemistry unspecified, whereas their current Rhea-selected ChEBI compounds specify it. Preserve a broader/native versus specific/current bridge, not exactMatch.

Original CPD12590 and current CHEBI136993 are linear. Official 2015 SI TableS3/FigureS2 depicts cyclic hemiaminal SB. A complete seven-step source-defined formal route may be represented only with an explicit endpoint convention and independent adjudication; it must not silently claim direct terminal linear-only physiological structure or substitute a cyclic structure under a linear ID.

Native intermediate molecular weights contradict their original structural formulas; pathway commentary mistakenly names SbnE as the decarboxylase where the original protein/reaction and primary identify SbnH. These source errors must not be copied.

native_linear.facts: Open-chain connectivity; dianion; citrate stereocenter unspecified in native InChI. It is broader than current stereospecific ChEBI136993, not an exact stereochemical match.

current_rhea_linear.facts: Current Rhea equation uses open-chain S-citrate SB dianion; independently replays with exact coefficients and atom/charge balance.

current_iubmb.facts: EC6.3.2.56, created2019, explicitly gives the linear chemical name for SB and assigns SbnC final ligation via the delta-acid of 2-oxoglutarate; its cited primary is Cheung2009. This is an issuing-authority reaction convention, not direct 2015 cyclic-form experimental evidence.

facts: Synthetic SB is characterized as a 1:1 mixture of two epimers due to equilibrating lactamization. NMR data are for the mixture, without assigning A/B resonances to individual epimers.
The terminal five-membered hemiaminal and its unspecified additional stereocenter are visible in the structures; the fixed amino-acid and citrate stereocenters are S.
The reported free-SB NMR conditions differ from the prior natural-source comparison. Do not generalize those conditions to the Newman intracellular distribution.
The separate SBimide conversion to SB is not the same transformation as open-chain/hemiaminal equilibration.
The pH>10 statement in S4 concerns an earlier synthetic fragment, not a measured Newman SB distribution, and is not transferred.
primary_si.primary_main_limit: Publisher/indexed abstract and official publisher SI inspected. The 2015 full main original was not obtained; no invented local main-article digest. Abstract biological recovery refers to USA300 JE2, not Newman.

cyclic_issued_identity.provenance: PubChem substance SID318735782 version2, deposited Nikkaji J3.449.064C, carries the SB alias and cyclic structure. Current compound PUGView lists SB among Removed Synonyms; synonym endpoint404 is preserved. Therefore use the current systematic compound name, not a supposedly current canonical SB alias. Direct Nikkaji source retrieval returned503.
cyclic_issued_identity.stereochemical_scope: Two fixed S centers plus unspecified hemiaminal stereocenter. It denotes the neutral cyclic structural class, not one isolated hemiaminal epimer or the Rhea dianion.
cyclic_issued_identity.bridge_limit: Exact isomeric identity to a human transcription of the visually inspected original SI structure was computationally verified. The transcription is not an issuing source and does not itself create an identifier.

rejected_alias_shortcuts: NP-MRD NP0267341 has linear-connectivity InChI SIAZVTIHOHTZDD-PWJLMRLQSA-N despite an imidic-acid SMILES; it is not a cyclic identifier.
RCSB3MWF SE8 and KEGGC22075 in the prior dossier remain linear structures.
Equal molecular formulas or shared SB names do not establish exact identity between ring and chain.

derivation.retained_actual_result: Prior actual original-source replay passed7directions/40sides/7balances. No reaction or source-body change in this endpoint adjudication; unchanged bodies and receipts rehashed rather than relabeling a replay as newly executed.
derivation.atp_scope: Five ATP per formal SB is a network sum: two ATP-to-ADP kinase turnovers and three ATP-to-AMP ligations. It is not a direct measured ATP/product ratio or cellular energetic yield.
derivation.protein_scope: All seven selected versioned Newman NCBI proteins retain exact genome-CDS and full current UniProt sequence bridges from the sealed prior dossier. Do not relabel NCTC8325 UniProt provenance as Newman; experimental constructs and relevant other experimental strains remain explicit.
derivation.assemblies: Retain native SbnI CPLX9312 and SbnB CPLX9313 where supported. SbnA and SbnH dimer observations do not mint new assembly IDs; functional protein roles must not imply monomer sufficiency. SbnC/E/F monomer/dimer mixtures remain unresolved, not fixed stoichiometries.
derivation.outside_boundary: SbnG citrate supply, SbnD transport, iron-complex formation and cellular ring-chain distribution are biologically relevant but are not additional members of the exact seven-object PWY8008 definition. Retain their disposition, not a false assertion of biological absence.

acceptance_guards: All seven native members and40Rhea sides survive source-to-graph and reverse coverage checks.
CHEBI136993 is always described as the formal open-chain dianion; no exactMatch to PubChem122234488 or unspecified nativeCPD12590.
Terminal Rhea source assertion is kept separate from primary product-characterization evidence.
Primary SI cannot be cited as experimental proof of a linear-only physiological product.
No fabricated ring-chain reaction ID, catalyst, or single hemiaminal stereoisomer.
Do not claim 5ATP measured or infer obligatory free-Mg binding from assay inclusion alone.
Cite thesis under its own DOI/body scope; do not assign its text/hash to an uninspected journal body.
scope: Selected facts; original articles/database commentary are not reproduced. No exact-match assertion between cyclic/linear or stereospecific/unspecified forms.
